items.content: Exactly two Test::More subtests in t/files.t. Control: read_file("$dir/docs", 'note.txt') returns hello. Exploit: with secret.txt beside the root, read_file("$dir/docs", '../secret.txt') dies and $@ matches outside root. My::Files::read_file in lib/My/Files.pm owns the containment check; the filesystem is a temporary directory and read_file is never redefined.
File names from the download handler reach My::Files::read_file. A name such as ../secret.txt may resolve outside the document root and return another file.
